name: Adrian104/Dungeon-Generator
description: A seed-driven BSP-based procedural 2D dungeon map generator producing deterministic, reproducible layouts with configurable room count and corridor style. Lightweight and engine-agnostic.
score_rationale: Well-structured BSP dungeon generator with deterministic seed support making it easy to reproduce and share layouts.
summary: Seed-driven BSP dungeon generator with deterministic reproducible layouts.
